Governor Kehoe Announces Four Gubernatorial Appointments

October 30, 2026

Jefferson City

Today, Governor Mike Kehoe announced one gubernatorial appointment and filled three county vacancies.
Billy Crawford
, of Marshfield, was appointed as the 
Webster County Northern Commissioner
.
Mr. Crawford owns Crawford Tire and currently serves as the interim Webster County northern commissioner. In addition to his professional career, he is also an active member of Four Rivers Church. Crawford graduated from Marshfield High School.
Robert Clary
, of Alton, was appointed as the 
Oregon County Coroner
.
Mr. Clary and his family own and operate Clary Funeral Home, and he currently serves as the deputy coroner of Oregon County. He is president of the Alton R-IV Public School Foundation. Clary completed the mortuary science and funeral arts program at John A. Gupton Mortuary School.
Jaimie Umhoefer
, of Mayview, was appointed as the 
Lafayette County Auditor
.
Ms. Umhoefer served as a finance manager for the Forest T. Jones Company before being appointed interim auditor for Lafayette County. She currently serves as treasurer of the Lafayette County Emergency Services Board and the Mayview Fire Ladies Auxiliary. Umhoefer holds a Bachelor of Science in Business and a Master of Business Administration from Missouri Baptist University.
Thomas Salisbury
, of Kansas City, was appointed to the 
Clay County Board of Election Commissioners
.
Mr. Salisbury served as a district director for the Office of Senator Roy Blunt before retiring. He previously served as the Clay County public administrator and currently serves on the Clay County Tax Increment Financing Commission. Salisbury holds a Bachelor of Science in Education from the University of Missouri–Columbia.
